x-ectwin.runs_in: Commons forecast-cycle workflow, one request per basin per cycle; Heavy tenants may reuse it before Cloud Batch runs in their own project
x-ectwin.payer: Commons sponsor (national scenario library); tenant for tenant runs

placeholders.floodhub_signal: Bucket label from code, e.g. 'no gauge above warning', 'above warning level at 2 gauges', 'above danger level at 1 gauge'
placeholders.weathernext_signal: Bucket label from code, e.g. 'heavy rain probability low', 'heavy rain probability high, rising vs last run'
placeholders.last_hires_run_age: Bucket label from code: 'less than 6 h', '6-24 h', 'older than 24 h', 'never run this season'
placeholders.enfen_statement: Latest CN-ERFEN / ENFEN statement paragraph relevant to the coast (verbatim Spanish), or empty string
placeholders.inamhi_special_warning: Paragraphs of the latest INAMHI advertencia that mention provinces drained by the basin (extracted by code), or empty string

hard_rules_before_jev: If any gauge in the basin is at or above the danger level: run hires_2d without asking Jev (Jev cannot veto).
If the per-cycle compute budget cap for the basin is reached: do not run; route to a human who may raise the cap.
If no new forecast data arrived since the last run: do not run.
notes: Jev can make the gate stricter but never looser: code hard rules always win.
The full_ensemble tier always needs human approval because of its cost.

run_hires_inundation.instructions: Given `signals`, `enfen_statement` and `inamhi_special_warning`, is a new high-resolution inundation model run for `basin` justified now?

criteria.true: Signals point to significant flooding in the next days and the last high-resolution run is stale or no longer matches the signals
criteria.false: Signals are weak or unchanged and current products remain adequate

warning_mentions_basin.instructions: Does `inamhi_special_warning` mention provinces or rivers drained by `basin`?

run_tier.instructions: Which analysis tier fits the situation described by `signals` for `basin`?

criteria.full_ensemble: Full ensemble downscaling for all members
